primary_kpi.metric: commercially relevant Google queries in Top 5 organic positions
primary_kpi.note: This is an operating target, not a guaranteed Google outcome. Every sprint must maximize probability of reaching it with evidence-based work.

core_money_pillars.balance_rule: Choose the highest-value evidence-backed sprint, but do not allow one pillar to consume more than two consecutive weekly sprints when the other pillar has a material ranking opportunity.

local_demand_policy.primary_local_signal: Antwerp Province Keyword Planner demand as a proxy for the active service area
local_demand_policy.national_context: Belgium Keyword Planner demand for market breadth and content discovery
local_demand_policy.decision_rule: Combine Antwerp local demand with GSC, current rankings, intent fit and business-profile service-area rules. Never treat Province volume as exact 20-25 km demand.
local_demand_policy.health_requirement: Every weekly run should distinguish Belgium Keyword Planner health from Antwerp local Keyword Planner health and surface a warning if the local scope fails.

search_intent_layers.commercial: Direct service and local buying-intent queries.
search_intent_layers.problem: Symptoms and homeowner problems that insulation can plausibly help solve.
search_intent_layers.economic: Cost, energy-use, payback and heating/cooling efficiency questions without inventing savings.
search_intent_layers.comfort: How the home feels: cold walls, heat upstairs, rapid cooling, uncomfortable attic, temperature stability.
search_intent_layers.seasonal: Demand that rises with weather, heating season, summer heat, renovation cycles or current subsidy/rule changes.

weekly_sprint_rule.unit_of_work: one keyword/service cluster, not one micro-fix
expected_output: complete all safe related on-page/internal-link/technical fixes that materially support the cluster
prepare one approval package when a new article/new URL/merge/redirect is the highest-value next move
measure target-query positions and report movement toward the 40-keyword Top-5 KPI
weekly_sprint_rule.micro_fix_rule: A minor metadata or formatting fix may be included in a sprint but should not be the sole weekly objective when a higher-impact ranking task is supported by evidence.

new_content_only_when: there is verified relevant search demand or a strong GSC/content gap
the intent is distinct enough to avoid cannibalizing an existing page
the topic can naturally support a commercial service page or local conversion path

spring: facade renovation and exterior insulation planning
summer: air-conditioning demand versus improving roof envelope
seasonal_rules.freshness_guardrail: Never change a year, subsidy, regulation, energy price, savings claim or legal/financial fact without verifying a current authoritative source.

telegram_must_show: one approval request only when needed
github_report_must_show: what is blocked by approval or off-page factors
